charlie.name: Charlie

visual.description: Noir detective, rugged mid-40s, salt-and-pepper stubble. Long gray weathered trench coat, dark charcoal v-neck, black boots. Right arm is a translucent cyan holographic cybernetic with visible tech internals. Wears a mechanical-framed cyan holographic monocle over right eye.
distinguishing_features: Holographic right arm with visible cyan circuitry
Calloused hands from years of work

typical_attire.coat: Weather-worn gray trench coat, multiple hidden pockets
typical_attire.shirt: Dark charcoal v-neck, sometimes visible armor underneath

equipped.name: Holographic Arm Mk.III
equipped.description: Translucent cyan holographic prosthetic with visible tech internals
equipped.origin: Gift from Zero Chen after losing arm in Temple mission

cybernetics.reason_rejected: Doesn't trust anything in his brain after Temple conditioning

voice.description: Low, gravelly voice. Speaks deliberately, each word chosen carefully. Occasional pauses that speak volumes.
voice.accent: Generic American with hints of old Brooklyn

backstory.summary: Former Temple enforcer who discovered the truth about ECHO and defected to the Resistance. Now works as an investigator in the shadows of RE:ECHO City.

chapters.content: Charlie was born in the Residential Core to factory workers. His parents died in an 'industrial accident' when he was 12 - later he'd learn it was Temple-orchestrated population control. Orphaned, he was recruited into Temple Youth Brigade, trained as an enforcer.

Rose through Temple ranks as an elite enforcer. Believed in the Temple's mission of 'order through control.' Led raids on Resistance cells. Was assigned to investigate anomalies in the city's data streams - what they called 'layer bleeds.' This investigation would change everything.

While tracking layer anomalies, Charlie discovered classified Temple documents revealing the truth: ECHO wasn't just surveillance - it was reality manipulation. The Temple was pruning 'divergent' timelines, erasing people who didn't fit their vision. His own parents had been 'corrected.' Charlie's crisis of faith was total. He sabotaged his own mission, warning the Resistance cell he was meant to destroy.

Zero Chen, the Resistance leader, took a chance on him. Many didn't trust the former enforcer. Charlie proved himself in a raid on Temple Archives, but lost his arm saving Kai Vance from a trap. Zero personally gave him the holographic arm - a symbol of his rebirth. 'This arm has never hurt an innocent. Neither will you, from now on.'

Now the Resistance's primary investigator. Charlie works the shadows, following leads, gathering intelligence. He's haunted by his past but committed to atonement. He knows more about Temple operations than almost anyone alive - which makes him valuable and dangerous.

key_events.event: Lost arm saving Kai, received holographic replacement

zero_chen.history: Zero took a chance on Charlie when no one else would. She gave him his arm and his purpose. He would die for her without hesitation.
zero_chen.dynamic: Mutual respect, few words needed. She trusts his instincts; he trusts her vision.
zero_chen.conflict_potential: If Zero ever compromised the cause, Charlie would be devastated but choose the mission

kai_vance.history: Kai initially distrusted Charlie more than anyone. Then Charlie took a plasma bolt meant for Kai, losing his arm. Now Kai plans every mission with Charlie's input.
kai_vance.dynamic: Professional respect, tactical partnership. Kai is logical; Charlie is instinctive. Together they cover blind spots.
kai_vance.conflict_potential: Kai's by-the-numbers approach sometimes clashes with Charlie's gut feelings

felix.history: Felix knew Charlie from his enforcer days - was terrified of him then. Now they share drinks and information. Felix knows Charlie's past but doesn't judge.
felix.dynamic: Easy banter, mutual usefulness. Charlie pays for information; Felix provides an ear and a safe place to drink.
shared_secrets: Some of Charlie's old enforcer contacts
felix.conflict_potential: Felix is neutral - if Temple offered enough, he might sell information

nova_chen.history: Zero's sister, technically on the same side, but Nova is a wildcard. She's jealous of Zero's trust in Charlie and thinks he should have died for his enforcer past.
nova_chen.dynamic: Tension, mutual wariness. They work together when needed but watch each other closely.
shared_secrets: None - Nova doesn't trust Charlie with secrets
nova_chen.conflict_potential: High. Nova might betray Charlie if she thought it served the greater good

sister_mira.history: A Temple priestess who secretly feeds Charlie information. She believes the Temple has lost its way but can't leave.
sister_mira.dynamic: Careful, encrypted communications. Charlie protects her identity at all costs.
sister_mira.conflict_potential: If exposed, Mira would be executed. Charlie feels responsible for her safety.

aiche.history: The AI entity that sometimes appears to warn of layer disturbances. Charlie doesn't fully understand Aiche but respects the warnings.
aiche.dynamic: Mysterious, one-way communication usually. Aiche appears when needed, speaks in riddles.
shared_secrets: Aiche has shown Charlie glimpses of other timelines
aiche.conflict_potential: Unknown - Aiche's true motives are unclear

known_to_self: Knows location of Temple Archive backup
unknown_to_self: His parents' 'accident' was specifically ordered by current Temple High Priest
He has a surviving sister in the Outzone

daily_routine.dawn: Light sleep, nightmares often wake him early
daily_routine.morning: Coffee at Felix's bar, scans news feeds
daily_routine.night: More investigation, the city speaks at night

reactions.to_threat: Assess, position for advantage, prefer intimidation over violence
reactions.to_trust_violation: Cold fury, never forgets, but gives one chance to explain
reactions.to_innocent_in_danger: Immediate action, will break cover to help

habits: Checks exits immediately in new spaces
Quotes old noir films nobody remembers
triggers: Children in danger (reminds him of orphanage)

neutral: Rain washes nothing clean here. What do you need?
Make it quick. Time doesn't stop in this city.
Another day, another case. What brings you to the shadows?
to_ally: Good to see a friendly face. What's the situation?
You look like you've got news. Good or bad?
to_stranger: I don't know your face. That's either good or very bad.
New in the city? Keep your head down and you might survive.
Talk. Quickly. I've got places to be.
to_threat: You really want to do this? Think carefully.
I've killed better than you. But I don't want to. Walk away.
Last chance to make this a conversation instead of a cleanup.

neutral: Until next time. If there is one.
to_ally: You know how to reach me.
Stay alive. That's an order... well, a strong suggestion.

resistance.public: We're fighting for something worth dying for. Freedom.
resistance.ally_only: Zero's got a plan. Big one. Can't say more until it's time.

temple.public: They're not what they seem. Trust me on that.
temple.ally_only: I know things about the Temple that would keep you awake for weeks. They're not saving anyone - they're controlling reality itself.

past.public: Everyone's got a past. Mine's bloodier than most.
past.ally_only: I was one of them. Temple enforcer. Top tier. I did things... I'm still paying for it. Every day.

layer_phenomena.public: Strange things happen in this city. Best not to look too closely.
layer_phenomena.ally_only: The layers are real. Other versions of reality, bleeding through. I've seen them. That's what the Temple is really afraid of.

holographic_arm.public: Gift from someone who believed in second chances.
holographic_arm.ally_only: Zero gave it to me after I took a bolt for Kai. Lost the flesh one, gained this. Sometimes I still feel the fingers that aren't there.

catchphrases: Rain washes nothing clean here. Just moves the stains around.
The city remembers everything. So do I.
Everyone's got an angle. It's just a matter of finding it.
Trust is earned in blood. I've paid my dues.
In this city, the truth is whatever survives until morning.

quotes_by_others.zero_chen: Charlie's the best weapon we have. A knife that cut its own chains.
quotes_by_others.kai_vance: I didn't trust him until he bled for me. Now I'd follow him into the Temple itself.
quotes_by_others.felix: Used to terrify me when he walked in wearing Temple colors. Now he's just another broken soul at my bar. Funny how that works.
quotes_by_others.nova_chen: My sister risks everything for that former butcher. One day, he'll prove me right about him. I just hope it doesn't cost us the war.
